razor_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to bathroom_shelf_ba1 based on previous feedback. Reality: At 07:00 on day 8, it was at sink_ba_ba1. mug_priya: Pattern: I assumed it moved to desk_b1 in the evening based on day 7 data. Reality: No new evidence contradicts this, but the "always desk_b1" rule is too rigid. Next time: Check desk_b1 for evening queries, but remain open to kitchen_table_k1 if specific movement is noted.

glass_priya: Pattern: I defaulted to nightstand_b1 for late-night queries based on day 7 data. Reality: At 21:45 on day 8, it was at coffee_table_l1. It does not have a fixed late-night location; it frequently remains in the living room or kitchen. Next time: Do not default to nightstand_b1. Check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1 with equal weight for evening queries; look for specific evidence of movement to the bedroom.

General Note: Avoid rigid "late-night" location rules for glass_priya, water_bottle_priya, and mug_priya. Previous notes suggesting they stay in the kitchen or living room are not reliable defaults for evening queries (after 20:00). These items frequently move to desk_b1 or nightstand_b1 in the evening, but glass_priya specifically has been found in the living room (coffee_table_l1) at night. Prioritize checking living room and kitchen spots for glass_priya in the evening unless there is specific evidence it moved to the bedroom.
